item.text:
Audited all 39 Roman verse lines against the Urdu in [ta-hashr-zikr-hoga.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/3/workspaces/5cb42c8e1e734080b15e9c38a3919d75/src/data/lyrics/ta-hashr-zikr-hoga.md). Corrected vowels, nasal endings, aspiration, izafat, and capitalization. Updated the Roman title to “Taa Hashr Zikr Hoga” and preserved the Urdu text and verse layout.

Retained the existing reading `zad` for `ضد` in the storm verse. That reading remains for human editorial sign-off.
